## Course Overview

This course introduces students to the principles of health economics and its application in healthcare decision-making.

## Topics Covered

- Introduction to health economics
- Demand and supply in healthcare
- Costing in healthcare
- Cost-effectiveness analysis
- Cost-utility analysis
- Budget impact analysis

## Target Audience

This course is suitable for public health students, researchers, healthcare professionals, and policymakers.

## Duration

6 weeks

## Mode

Online / Offline
